summary: On the main deck, Tank answers a call. Morpheus, heard only as a voice, urgently instructs him: "Tank, find a structural drawing of this building and find it fast." Tank is thereby set to the task of locating a blueprint of the building.

what_changes.before: Answering a call without a stated task.
what_changes.after: Given a specific, urgent objective to locate a structural drawing of the building.
what_changes.evidence: Tank, find a structural drawing of this building and find it fast.

event_hint.one_line: As Morpheus is trapped in the building, Tank is directed to find a structural drawing to locate an escape route.

objects_that_matter: a structural drawing of the building
uncertain: Whether Tank is the only person present on the main deck.
